summary: Physical audit of the three M1 FX panels (EURUSD/GBPUSD/USDJPY, BID+ASK, 12,552 .bi5 files, 111,757,566 bytes) completed with zero anomalies: 0 missing/0-byte/undecodable files, format empirically pinned (24-byte BE records, price divisors 1e5/1e5/1e3, 0 OHLC violations, 0 negative spreads), all 12,552 sha256 recorded with per-side/pair/overall aggregate digests (DATA_FREEZE input ready) and 100% agreement with the staged per-file manifests. Two material findings for the strategy class: (1) the dispatch's 'Dukascopy M1 volume = tick count' premise is REFUTED - the volume column is a size-weighted float32 sum of per-tick volumes (integer fraction only 2.5-3.7% of active minutes), absolute unit unverifiable from candles; (2) COST_AUTHORITY_TABLE C1 (Friday 20:00) and C2-Friday reproduce EXACTLY, but the C2 Mon-Thu roll cell was measured on the wrong hour (matches 22:00-23:00Z, not its declared (21:00,22:00] window) and understates the declared window by ~1.3-2x (true p50/p90: EURUSD 1.2/3.7, GBPUSD 2.8/7.8, USDJPY 2.1/7.4 pips) - correct before costing roll-sensitive trials. Provenance: prior data_manifest_fx.json agrees on all material fields; 2 clerical errors flagged (non-reproducible largest-run field; 1-char hash typo).
